mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC for the joint signal over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by high consumer spending, a rising housing starts index signals strong demand for goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises in late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeds 750,000 million dollars for two consecutive months, it signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when RSAFS > 750000 for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), a rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises in the current month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals an overheating labor market that may lead to wage inflation and tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
